question_text:
If the tool does not load, open it in a new tab.

Use the tool above, then paste its output here. It will not let you finish until your points add up correctly, and it writes the strengths and improvements into the same block. Everything the tool needs to explain is inside it — open the two grey sections at the top if you want the detail.

Your answer should look like this:

POINTS
abc123@your-university.edu = 110
bcd456@your-university.edu = 100
cde789@your-university.edu = 90

STRENGTHS
bcd456@your-university.edu: built the card deck
cde789@your-university.edu: wrote the rulebook

IMPROVEMENTS
bcd456@your-university.edu: n/a
cde789@your-university.edu: missed the second build session

Justification. Required for any rating you gave below 80 or above 120. Explain it in terms of tasks assigned and tasks completed — not personality. Name the person by email.

Write n/a if every rating you gave was between 80 and 120.

Anything else your instructor should know? Never shared with your teammates. Write n/a if nothing.

If something on your team needs attention now rather than at grading time, email directly — do not wait for this form.
